jordan (Customer): Hey team — after the cert rotation ~06:10 UTC this morning several users in acme corp see 401s at login, SAML assertion recipient mismatch in our logs. We rolled certs back on our IdP but still failing. Any quick ideas?

maya (Support): Sorry you're hitting this. Can you DM or paste a redacted SAMLResponse and the RelayState/entityID your IdP is sending? Also which IdP (Okta/ADFS/Onelogin)?

jordan (Customer): Okta. Pasting redacted: `SAMLResponse: (base64)...` RelayState: `/app/acme/launch` entityID: `https://acme.okta.com/app/abcd1234?env=prod` — noticed the `?env=prod` querystring on entityID.

sam (Eng-oncall): Hmm entityID with query params is a red flag. Our SP normalization strips querystring normally, but we recently deployed the metadata ingest change tied to cert rotation days ago. Possible regress. Can you share the auth service logs around the failed assertion?

jordan (Customer): Pasted error from our side: `2026-03-17T06:12:08Z auth[web-2]: SAML validation failed: Recipient mismatch: expected https://redwood.example.com/sso/acs but got https://redwood.example.com/sso/acs/` (note trailing slash) and `Assertion signature invalid -> key thumbprint mismatch`

maya (Support): Two separate issues visible: 1) trailing slash vs non-trailing slash in ACS recipient, 2) signature validation failing (likely due to cert thumbprint change). Both started after rotation — maybe metadata ingestion reordered KeyDescriptors or we applied entityID normalization bug.

aru (SRE): I pulled the deploy diff. We changed the metadata canonicalization to be stricter (keeps querystring) in commit 9f3b2a to support multiple envs, but didn't add backward compat for entityIDs with trailing slash variants. That explains `?env=prod` and recipient slash.

sam (Eng-oncall): Repro steps for us: 
1) grab IdP metadata from Okta (the metadata URL jordan supplied).
2) POST a test SAMLResponse to our ACS: `curl -v -X POST https://redwood.example.com/sso/acs -F 'SAMLResponse=<base64>' -F 'RelayState=/app/acme/launch'`
We see 400/401 and the logs show `recipient mismatch` and `signature key not found` for that assertion.

maya (Support): Short-term workaround: 1) Ask IdP admin to: a) remove the `?env=prod` from entityID in the application config (or add an explicit entityID without qs) and b) configure ACS without trailing slash. 2) We'll roll back the metadata ingest change to restore previous normalization while we patch.

jordan (Customer): Can you roll back on your side? Changing a bunch of Okta apps would be painful for us mid-day.

aru (SRE): Initiating rollback of metadata normalization now (deploy-bot triggered).deploy-bot: "deploy triggered: rollback metadata-ingest 9f3b2a -> previous 8c1d0b"

sam (Eng-oncall): Also, for the signature issue: looks like IdP rotated a signing cert and Okta still advertises both new and old certs but our ingest respected order and picked only the first key. We'll accept multiple keys, but for a quick fix I'm adding the old cert thumbprint back into our keystore so signatures validate.

maya (Support): Jordan — we will: a) rollback normalization (done), b) re-add the old cert thumbprint to keystore (in progress). Expect auths to start succeeding in ~5–10 mins. Sorry for the disruption.

jordan (Customer): Thanks, appreciate the fast follow. Fingers crossed.

(5 minutes later)

aru (SRE): Old cert thumbprint re-added and keystore reloaded. Auth logs show retries passing: `SAML validation ok for user alice@acme.com`.

jordan (Customer): OK! Logging in works for our testers now. :tada: Any postmortem steps so this doesn't recur?

sam (Eng-oncall): Postmortem action items: 
- Revert commit 9f3b2a permanently to avoid strict querystring canonicalization until we add entityID normalization tests.
- Update metadata ingestion to allow multiple KeyDescriptor entries and try all keys when validating signatures.
- Add ACS recipient normalization tolerant to trailing slash variants.
- Add e2e test for IdP metadata with querystrings and trailing slashes.

maya (Support): I'll open a customer-facing incident note and communicate the workaround we applied. Jordan — we'll follow up with a timeline for the permanent fix and testing window.

jordan (Customer): Thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick rollback and patch.

sam (Eng-oncall): Filing issue ENG-6521 and SRE runbook updates. Marking incident resolved for now — please reopen if you see any new failures. :thumbsup:
